The word **"doge"** (as in the meme and cryptocurrency) is pronounced like **"dohj"**—rhyming with **"odge"** or **"lodge"** but starting with a "d" sound.

- **IPA:** /doʊdʒ/
- **Phonetic spelling:** "DOHJ"

This pronunciation comes from the original "Doge" meme, which itself was a misspelling of "dog" and was popularized with this pronunciation in internet culture.

If you mean the historical title **"Doge of Venice"**, it is pronounced the same way: **"DOHJ"**.
